metadata.name: Short Description (completed by Recruitment)
metadata.value: As a D2L Solutions Consultant, you'll spend every day helping those around you get the most out of D2L products and services. Working alongside the Corporate Sales team, you'll help D2L prospects and clients by learning about their unique needs and proposing D2L products and services as the solution to meet those needs. Your passion for teaching and learning makes people want to open up to you, and your expertise in learning technology and how to accomplish nearly anything using the D2L platform makes you a trusted advisor. You're excited to speak to everyone from corporate learners and instructional designers, to a CIO or CEO, and your demos and presentations provoke gasps of amazement, if not outright applause.

title: Solutions Consultant - Corporate
